name: ema200_dip_reversal_5s
author: adapted from aggregated_from_x_indian_traders
thesis: Exploiting bounces from 200-period EMA on 5-min after multi-day support formation. Inefficiency from retail panic selling at visible levels. Not arbitraged because requires 2-day prior support + volume spike; costs + latency kill it for non-quants.
mechanism: Short-term selling exhausts available demand at a price level, creating a temporary liquidity vacuum. Market makers who absorbed the selling begin marking prices back to reduce inventory risk. Limit buy orders resting below create a floor, and new participants entering the long side accelerate the reversion as the forced selling pressure dissipates.

indicators.name: multi_day_support
indicators.formula: price touched ema_200_5min on 2+ prior days

weaknesses: Regime dependency: strong downtrends break 200 EMA
Liquidity constraints: slower stocks have execution lag
Crowding: Ashwani Gujral style widely followed on X
prior_art: 200 EMA dip + multi-day support (Ashwani Gujral X post)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
